pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding authorized within 300 seconds of a prior ticket execution on the same asset class to eliminate clustered toxic fills.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Volume delta and order-book imbalance must align with the primary trend direction for at least two consecutive 1-minute bars prior to fill authorization.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing profit locks dynamically at +$10.00 unrealized to ensure winners reach the target $15-$30+ asymmetry band.
